observations.behavior: Adds dedicated flags Redis cache alias and secondary cache mirroring, including ETag and delete handling, and Prometheus failure counter.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds FLAGS_DEDICATED_CACHE_ALIAS to HyperCache, wiring dedicated Redis for flags; P1.F3.H3 documents the migration and SDK cache split.

observations.behavior: Adds documentation warning and Prometheus metric for mirror failures.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a Prometheus counter to track secondary cache mirror failures, distinguishing them from primary write failures.

observations.behavior: Adds secondary cache mirroring for ETag and payload, and checks secondary ETag before skipping writes.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks secondary cache availability and ETag match before skipping writes, preventing drift when secondary is unavailable.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, conservative group. No tier assignment is made; score is withheld. No score is assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a dedicated cache alias and its mirror to the feature-flags HyperCache, and pins the rebuild queue Redis client to the shared cluster.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the feature-flags cache to use a dedicated Redis alias while still mirroring to the shared Redis, and prevents the rebuild queue from accidentally reading a different Redis than the cache it heals.
